source.name: Aeon Disk
source.description:
Carrier and its minions will be a
 permanent chess piece.

Active ability: Activates when at low health.
Grants 100% damage block for 3.5 seconds.

Носитель и его призывные юниты

source.lore: A powerful artifact long ago smuggled out of the Ivory Incubarium. Or so many believe.
